examples.ar: دَرَّجَ الحِرَفِيُّ طَوْقَ الأَسْطُرْلاَبِ إِلَى ثَلاَثِمِائَةٍ وَسِتِّينَ دَرَجَةً دَقِيقَةً.
examples.de: Der Kunsthandwerker graduierte den Rand des Astrolabiums in dreihundertsechzig präzise Grade.
examples.en: The artisan graduated the rim of the astrolabe into three hundred and sixty precise degrees.
